item.title: North Charleston POPS! Presents “Sounds of the Season”
item.description: The North Charleston POPS! is kicking off the holidays with Sounds of the Season, its much-loved annual Holiday Pops! concert, on Saturday, December 20 at the North Charleston Performing Arts Center.

item.title: TriCounty Link Hosting Virtual, Zoom Transit Study Open House on Monday
item.description: TriCounty Link (TCL) is hosting a virtual open house on Zoom, Monday, December 8, from 3:30 p.m.-4:30 p.m. to support its upcoming transit study project. This virtual open house will be drop-in style and will not include a formal presentation.

item.title: Liberty Fellowship Opens Nominations for the Next Class of South Carolina Leaders
item.description: Liberty Fellowship is now accepting nominations for its next Class of Fellows. The nomination form is available online at libertyfellowshipsc.org/nominate.

item.title: Newly Remodeled Summerville Walmart Neighborhood Market Re-Opens with Customer-Centric Features
item.description: Walmart customers in Summerville were welcomed inside the newly transformed Neighborhood Market at 10635 Dorchester Road, Summerville, SC 29485 this morning as the much-anticipated project is now complete.

item.title: Leadership announced for 2026 heart health events in the Lowcountry
item.description: The American Heart Association, a relentless force changing the future of health for everyone, everywhere, proudly announces the volunteer chairs who will lead four 2026 campaigns

item.title: The Society of Bluffton Artists Announces 2025 Holiday Market
item.description: The Society of Bluffton Artists (SOBA) is celebrating the season of giving and creativity with its Annual Holiday Market, open November 3 through December 28 at the SOBA Art Gallery in Old Town Bluffton.

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Charleston Christmas Special's Brad Moranz
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with a Charleston news maker. You can watch the interview below.

item.title: Stingrays Fall in Overtime to Ghost Pirates, 4-3
item.description: The South Carolina Stingrays rallied in the 3rd period to force overtime, but could not find a game-winning goal in the extra frame as the Savannah Ghost Pirates took the full two points with a 4-3 win over the Stingrays on Friday evening

item.title: Lowcountry Youth Services Awarded $70,000 Grant from Power:Ed to Strengthen Youth Mentoring and Leadership Programs
item.description: Lowcountry Youth Services (LYS), a nonprofit organization empowering youth across Charleston, Berkeley and Dorchester counties, has received a $70,000 grant from Power:Ed, the philanthropic arm of the South Carolina Student Loan Corporation.

item.title: Wu-Tang Clan Legend GZA to Bring Liquid Swords 30th Anniversary Tour to North Charleston
item.description: GZA, a rapper and founding member of the Wu-Tang Clan, will perform with the Phunky Nomads Band at Building 64 in North Charleston on Friday, Jan. 9, at 8 p.m. The show is part of his Liquid Swords 30th Anniversary Tour.
